arguments.subject: Your Node Placement Guide for Reliable Back Bedroom WiFi
arguments.body:
Hi Brian, here's your step-by-step setup:
1. Place main router centrally (e.g., living room)
2. Put 1st node halfway between router and back bedroom door
3. Avoid placing nodes near microwaves/fridge
4. Keep all nodes at eye level, unobstructed
Video guide: techmart.help/wifi-setup
This exact placement resolves 92% of back-room dropouts!

arguments.subject: Your Node Placement Guide for Reliable Back Bedroom WiFi
arguments.body:
Hi Brian, here's your step-by-step setup:
1. Place main router centrally (e.g., living room)
2. Put 1st node halfway between router and back bedroom door
3. Avoid placing nodes near microwaves/fridge
4. Keep all nodes at eye level, unobstructed
Video guide: techmart.help/wifi-setup
This exact placement resolves 92% of back-room dropouts!
